name: io.github.Rahulk644/appflowy-mcp-server
title: AppFlowy Workspace MCP
description: Edit AppFlowy documents and typed rows, search workspaces, and import/export Markdown.

environmentVariables.name: APPFLOWY_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Dedicated bot account email (or use an access token)

environmentVariables.name: APPFLOWY_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: AppFlowy token, as an alternative to email/password

environmentVariables.name: ALLOWED_WORKSPACE_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated workspace IDs this server may access

environmentVariables.name: APPFLOWY_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Disable writes and expose read-only tools
